title: Benefaction
summary: BENEFAC'TION, noun [Latin benefacio, of bene, well, and facio, to make or do.] 1. The act of conferring a benefit. More generally, 2. A benefit conferred, especially a charitable donation.

inlines.v: BENEFAC'TION, noun [Latin benefacio, of bene, well, and facio, to make or do.] 1. The act of conferring a benefit. More generally, 2. A benefit conferred, especially a charitable donation.
